workstreams.name: Customer analytics
workstreams.answers: Which prepaid customer groups churned more in 2025, and what changed in their behavior before leaving?
activities: Extract operational data on prepaid customer activity
Analyze 2025 churn by customer group and tenure
Interview customers who left in 2025

workstreams.name: Retention offers
workstreams.answers: How did prepaid customers respond to the retention offers, and where did the offers not hold them?
activities: Review documents on retention offers made to customers
Compare churn of customers with and without an offer
Interview commercial staff who design and run the offers

workstreams.name: Store operations
workstreams.answers: How do store processes and staff handling of prepaid customers contribute to churn?
activities: Observe how stores serve prepaid customers
Interview store staff and managers on churn and retention
Analyze operational data from stores on prepaid customers

workstreams.name: Customer analytics
workstreams.answers: Which prepaid customers should the program target, and which churn measures will show whether it works?
activities: Define target customer groups from the diagnostic findings
Set churn measures and tracking rules against the baseline

workstreams.name: Retention offers
workstreams.answers: Which offers make up the retention program for prepaid customers, and what rules govern each?
activities: Draft offer options from the diagnostic findings
Test the options with commercial staff and customers
Specify rules and tracking for each offer in the program

workstreams.name: Store operations
workstreams.answers: Which store actions and rollout steps carry the retention program to prepaid customers?
activities: Define store actions for each offer and customer group
Test store actions with store staff and managers
Sequence the rollout across stores and teams

workstreams.name: Retention offers
workstreams.answers: How do prepaid customers respond to the approved retention offers once they are live?
activities: Launch the approved offers to the target customer groups
Monitor offer uptake and refine rules with client teams
Gather customer feedback on the offers during rollout

workstreams.name: Store operations
workstreams.answers: Do store teams carry out the approved store actions, and what blocks them where they do not?
activities: Brief and train store teams on the approved store actions
Roll out the store actions following the agreed sequence
Check store adherence through visits and operational data

workstreams.name: Customer analytics
workstreams.answers: How far has prepaid churn moved against the diagnostic baseline since the program went live?
activities: Build the churn tracker against the diagnostic baseline
Compare churn by customer group and by store
Report early churn movement at check-in and readout
